news.title: Black Challenge arrive in Mexico for Amputee Football World Cup
news.lede: Ghana’s national amputee football team, the Black Challenge, have arrived in Mexico for the Amputee Football World Cup. The team touched down in Mexico ahead of the global tournament, where they will compete against some of the best amputee football nations in the world. The Black Challenge, who have consistently been one of Africa’s leading amputee football teams, will be looking to make a strong impression on the world stage and fly the flag of Ghana high. The team’s arrival in Mexico marks the final phase of their preparations, as they now turn their focus to acclimatising, settling in, and getting ready for their opening fixtures in the competition.

news.title: Argentina 1986–1990: Maradona’s World Cup Team
news.lede: Choose us as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Google Search. Argentina won the 1986 World Cup and reached the 1990 final under Carlos Bilardo, with Diego Maradona captaining both teams. The 1986 side combined tactical organisation, attacking partnerships and Maradona’s creativity to defeat West Germany 3–2 in the final. The 1990 team was less consistent and more reliant on defensive resilience, penalty-shootout victories, Sergio Goycochea’s goalkeeping and individual moments from Maradona and Claudio Caniggia.

news.title: Talks opened: Chelsea pushing to sign £67m World Cup star wanted by Aston Villa
news.lede: Chelsea have a few expensive decisions to make before January. The Blues went into the international break after a 1-0 defeat at Sunderland, where they couldn’t find a way back after falling behind to a penalty. Now, the transfer talk is gathering pace around what Xabi Alonso might do to freshen up his side. Alex Scott is still the name to watch in midfield, and the I Paper reports Chelsea have contacted Bournemouth about him, along with Liverpool and Arsenal, but The Telegraph says the Cherries intend to keep their best players through January.

news.title: Real Madrid Lectures Morocco on Management While Spain's Football Chaos Tells a Different Story
news.lede: Rabat – Morocco might be building a golden stadium, but does it have what it takes to manage a World Cup final? This is the argument Real Madrid reportedly presented to FIFA during the governing body's recent inspection visit to the Santiago Bernabéu. The Spanish club believes that impressive infrastructure alone cannot guarantee a successful tournament. Instead, it argues that experience, crowd control, and the ability to manage major sporting events should determine which country hosts the 2030 World Cup final.

news.title: Spain star Sancet makes World Cup pledge ahead of Basque Country debut
news.lede: The 26-year-old has made four appearances for the Spain team since his senior debut in 2023, but he's still eligible to play for his Basque regional squad. As Spain is a long standing member of both FIFA and UEFA, their international matches are official and count towards World Cup and European Championship qualification. However, the Basque Country team - also known as Euskadi - is not officially recognised by FIFA or UEFA, so players are able to play for both with no issue and Spain games would take priority. Whilst Sancet has no plans to not represent Spain moving forward, he's joined the combined the call of several Basque LaLiga players to request formal recognition from Spain's National Sports Council, and potentially in future compete in UEFA and FIFA competitions.

news.title: In December, Women’s 2027 World Cup tickets go on sale; Brazil ready to host the tournament
news.lede: Rio de Janeiro Tickets for next year’s Women’s World Cup in ​Brazil will go on sale ‌from December 1, organisers said ​on Friday, with an ⁠initial eight-day sales window opening ahead of the tournament’s draw on December ‌11. Fans will be able to purchase tickets ‌in categories one, two, and three, with prices starting from ⁠$ 5.32 in category three, depending on the matches selected. The tournament ​will offer several ‌ticket packages, including a Brazil team pass covering the hosts’ three group stage matches, an arena ‌pass providing access to ​matches at a chosen venue up to the quarterfinals, ⁠and a flex pass that allows fans to select three ‌eligible games.

news.title: The 10 greatest players in World Cup history
news.lede: There is no greater stage in football than the FIFA World Cup. It is where reputations are made, heroes are born, national dreams are realized and, sometimes, the finest careers are defined by a single moment. For some players, greatness is measured by the number of goals they score. For others, it is the trophies they lift, the finals they influence or the extraordinary performances that remain etched in the memories of generations.
